d: When Matt catches the younger kids snooping, he sets a trap. But he catches Dad instead.
Dad freaks out when he finds a joint in the house, and his trust for Matt may be lost.
Simon’s experiment with mind control backfires when Matt turns the tables and convinces him that he’s shrinking.

t: 7th Heaven: Breaking Up Is Hard to Do
st: Breaking Up Is Hard to Do
d: The Camden house feels like Heartbreak Hotel when Wilson and Mary split up and Matt gets a “Dear John” letter from Heather.

t: 7th Heaven: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
st: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
d: Lucy innocently courts trouble by prancing around the mall in a short skirt and high heels while Eric helps a not-so-innocent girl in a gang.
Mom’s muffins are so delicious she decides to go into business…and quickly burns out.
The girls learn that words can really hurt people, and Simon befriends a Holocaust survivor.
Mary loses her cool when she finds out her brother paid his friend to go out with her.

t: 7th Heaven: Lead, Follow or Get Out of the Way
st: Lead, Follow or Get Out of the Way
d: Mary wants to quit the basketball team when a new girl outperforms her.
Mary’s hurt and confused when her coach’s interest in her moves beyond the basketball court.

t: 7th Heaven: Stuck in the Middle with You
st: Stuck in the Middle with You
d: Two boys are fighting for Lucy’s affections, while Annie and Eric are fighting in a marriage-counseling group.
A mysterious personal ad in the school paper gets Matt more calls than he can handle.
The only thing keeping Mary from getting back on the court after her knee surgery is fear.
Simon attends his first make-out party and learns more about girls than how they kiss.
Lucy’s friend is killed in a tragic car accident, and Lucy feels that she’s to blame.
When the Camdens host a French foreign exchange student, everyone seems to be getting into trouble!

t: 7th Heaven: Time to Leave the Nest
d: Matt’s bending the rules and hinting about moving out...against Annie’s wishes.
Mary and Lucy set themselves up for disastrous dates and Eric unwittingly fixes his son up with the “Senior Slut.”
